Abort on before_text/stable-ID mismatch or formula, or any structure whose preservation is not verified.
Apply only these string prefixes; preserve every historical byte, note, hyperlink, validation, format, source link and unlisted value.
No status, priority, proof status, novelty, canonical-count or row-order changes.
No publication URL is guessed; add report links only after separately verified publication.
Do not apply completion prefixes before independent review accepts report and proposal.
